thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: sustained 429s for org=sentinel over the last 5m. Error spike on /v1/generate (rate-limit). Link: https://infra.redwood/alerts/7405001234
oncall-jamie: taking this, paging SRE
taylor (SRE): on it — what's the observed QPS and RL breach?
amy (SE): customer on a call, reported timeouts and partial completions. They pushed a large batch job ~10:04 UTC
infra-ops: metrics: sentinel peaked at 380 QPS, org RL was 200 QPS — token bucket exhausted, 50% requests getting 429s
taylor (SRE): thanks. plan: temporary org-level RL uplift +150 QPS for 15m, and disable heavy feature on customer side if possible. can someone apply the uplift?
infra-ops: running command now:
```
infractl rl adjust --org sentinel --add-qps 150 --duration 15m --ticket 7405001234 --reason "emergency spike"
```
ops-bot: action logged: rl.adjust request_id=adf3-7405 by infra-ops
infra-ops: applied +150 QPS, new org limit = 350 QPS. TTL 15m. watching rollback timer
oncall-jamie: monitoring traces — error rate dropped from 48% -> 12% within 60s :eyes:
taylor (SRE): good improvement. amy, can you ask customer to reduce batch size from 128 -> 32 for the next 30m? that'll help KV cache pressure
amy (SE): on it, they're onboard. they agreed to drop to 32 and pause non-critical backfills :white_check_mark:
jordan (PM): heads-up: disabling batch_agg_v2 flag for sentinel for immediate relief? that will route to the lightweight path
taylor (SRE): +1 to feature-flag disable if SE confirms behavior is acceptable
amy (SE): disabling now via feature-flag service
```
ffctl set sentinel batch_agg_v2 false --env prod --by "amy (SE)" --reason "live mitigation"
```
ops-bot: ff change applied: batch_agg_v2=false for sentinel (propagation ~20s)
infrastructure-ops: after flag flip, tail latencies 95pct dropped 300ms -> 120ms, error rate ~4%
oncall-jamie: keeping the uplift for now, will reduce to +50 after we see stable 5m window
taylor (SRE): agreed. set timer to step to +50 at +30m from now, and full rollback at +60m unless we see continued elevated legitimate load
infra-ops: updated plan: +150 immediate (applied), auto-step +50 at +30m, auto-remove at +60m. documented in ticket 7405001234
ops-bot: scheduled tasks: rl.stepdown @7405003034 (+30m) rl.remove @7405004834 (+60m)
amy (SE): customer confirms completions improving, they're rerunning smaller batches now. will continue to monitor on call
 taylor (SRE): please capture short-run metrics and a prompt set for postmortem. main hypothesis: customer-side batch job created unexpected KV cache churn + sustained QPS burst
jordan (PM): I'll coordinate postmortem and CS outreach. we should propose a permanent org QPS floor or better tooling for big-batch customers
oncall-jamie: handing off to taylor for next 30m watch — I'm available if escalate
taylor (SRE): taking over watch. will ping here at stepdown and rollback checks. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
incident-bot: reminder: maintenance actions recorded in ticket 7405001234. If further manual intervention, reply here
infra-ops: note: we also toggled an emergency soft-limit on the endpoint to prioritize small payloads (token-bucket weight tweak) — will include in follow-up notes
ops-bot: metrics snapshot attached (short URL): https://metrics.rw/s/7405001234/snapshot
taylor (SRE): resolving active pager for now; keeping thread open until auto-step completes. postmortem action item: run synthetic workload to reproduce KV churn and adjust batching recommendations
amy (SE): customer thanked the team, will wait for postmortem and suggested guardrails
jordan (PM): assigning PM follow-up to me. I'll open follow-up doc and schedule a brief with SE + SRE
ops-bot: thread archived when last action completes. last_message_ts updated
taylor (SRE): closing my watch after stepdown check in 30m, will post a short summary then
